personality: Archetype 2: Material You / Expressive + Editorial legibility (Fusion)
personality_one_liner: A warm, high-quality financial care dashboard that uses rich Teal, Clay, and Sage color blocks to make complex data approachable and highly legible for older adults.

color_rules: CRITICAL: Map 'bg-card' to Teal, 'bg-secondary' to Clay, and 'bg-muted' to Sage to enforce color blocking.
Never use pure white or pure black. Use the provided soft cream-sage background for light mode.
Ensure all text on Teal, Clay, and Sage backgrounds is strictly white.

headings.styles: Use tight letter spacing on headings; keep font weights strictly at 400 or 500.

web.layout: Control Room Grid for dashboards: tight gap-6, 12-col base. Use large horizontal color-blocked sections stacked vertically for marketing/info pages.
web.navigation_header: Solid Teal (bg-card) sticky header with hard bottom border; ensuring high contrast and trustworthiness.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: pure HTML + Tailwind for structural color-blocked layouts to avoid rigid shadcn Card limits
components_strategy.interactive_logic: shadcn heavily customized via Tailwind to apply the Teal/Clay/Sage color blocks with rounded lg corners
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react with stroke-width 2 to ensure legibility and friendliness
components_strategy.buttons: pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions, mapping to brand.radius_tokens.pill

glassmorphism.recipe: backdrop-blur-xl + backdrop-saturate-150 + bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) + 1px inner stroke

motion.hover_states: Soft -translate-y-1 lift and opacity shifts on buttons.
motion.buttons: transition-transform transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out; respect prefers-reduced-motion

web.data_testid: every interactive/key element gets a stable data-testid

dos: Use solid colored surfaces (Teal/Clay) instead of glass for data legibility.
donts: Do not use blur over dense financial data or forms.

mobile.safe_area: every screen root respects safe area; sticky primary CTA in a solid Teal/Clay container at the bottom where applicable
mobile.touch_targets: >=44x44pt (hitSlop if visual smaller); Pressable only; testID on all interactive elements

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level view combining financial pacing, account health, and recent statements using distinct color blocks.

states.loading: Centered Teal spinner on soft sage background.
states.empty: Teal-tinted illustration with a prompt to upload the first statement.
states.error: Clay-colored (error/brandSecondary) card with a readable retry message.

screens.layout: Hero block (Teal background, white text) with Account Health score -> Things To Know (Clay block, white text) -> Recent Statements (Sage block).

screens.name: Statement Decoder
screens.purpose: Decodes aged-care invoices into plain English, flagging anomalies clearly.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the colored card shapes.
states.empty: Illustration encouraging the user to select an invoice.
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Try Again' pill button.

screens.layout: Summary banner pinned to top (Teal). Scrollable list of anomaly/flag cards (Clay colored with white text) that are collapsible.

screens.name: AI Tools Hub
screens.purpose: A hub for Price Checker, Care Plan Reviewer, and Budget Calculator.
screens.layout: Tetris grid on web, single-column large cards on mobile. Cards alternate between Teal, Clay, and Sage to create a vibrant, engaging grid.

logo.fallback: WY, wayly logo aged care premium png

hero_background.description: Used as a rich, colorful gradient backdrop for the main Dashboard hero section.

lifestyle_marketing.description: Warm, engaging lifestyle photo of an older couple, to be used in onboarding or Guided Journeys.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The founder explicitly requested 'different sections should use different background colours and stand out' and 'less white/brown plain space, more colour'. You MUST use full-width color blocks for different layout sections.

Web Color Mapping: Use 'bg-card' (mapped to Teal #0E4D52), 'bg-secondary' (mapped to Clay #A5512B), and 'bg-muted' (mapped to Sage #6B8F71) for distinct layout wrappers, cards, and banners. This guarantees the high-contrast colored-block aesthetic requested.

Mobile Color Mapping: Use 'surfaceSecondary' (Teal), 'surfaceTertiary' (Clay), and 'surfaceInverse' (Sage) for main view containers, bottom sheet backgrounds, and large cards. Avoid using 'surface' (the light base) for everything.
Contrast Rule: Whenever you use Teal, Clay, or Sage as a background, text MUST be white. No exceptions. Ensure high legibility for older adults.
Gradients: Use custom arbitrary gradients for hero sections to satisfy the 'not just one flat colour' rule, e.g., 'bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0E4D52] to-[#166A70]' for the Teal sections.
No Glass on Data: Use solid, warm, colored surfaces for cards instead of glass/blur, which can read as cold and clinical in health/aged-care contexts.
